_comment: Core-specific. The SH7604's view of the MLC, from deco_mlc.cpp avengrgs_map (lines 304-325); the DE156 maps (327-355) are the same addresses without the 0xff000000 mirror. Read by mame_capture.py and write_timing.py. Addresses are hex strings, inclusive. spriteram holds 16-bit words in 32-bit slots (upper half reads 0xffff, lines 254-280). prev: the sprite list the captured frame is drawn from = m_buffered_spriteram, copied at vblank start (deco_mlc_v.cpp:545); the palette and the DMA'd top of VRAM as they were before the frame's line 9-11 DMAC copies, for the frame's first lines. addr_hi 0xffffffff: the trace keeps the full SH-2 address, so the cache-through mirror (0x20000000, driver .mirror(0xff000000)) and the on-chip registers (0xfffffe00-0xffffffff) stay visible. ipl: SR bits 7:4 are the SH-2 interrupt mask. trace.ram: the IRQ block (0x200000-7f) is not RAM: its reads are the toggling vblank bit and the scanline counter, replayed as I/O. trace.internal: the SH7604's on-chip registers, which never reach the external bus and are dropped from MAME's trace before comparing. vectors: the program's code starts at 0x200 (boot trace), so only vectors 0-127 count as interrupt vector reads; the scanline IRQ is auto-vectored to 64 (0x100). wtap irqregs: the IRQ block as written (rebuilt from writes since power-on, reg_irqregs.bin and _prev): words 0, 1, 28, 29, 31 read back constants or counters, not what was written, and word 1 is the alpha word.
